lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
He walks through the debris where the shadows used to grow
Tracing every fracture in the pavement, feeling every blow
He counts the heavy secrets that the winter tried to keep
Sowing seeds of courage in the garden of his sleep
The city is a heartbeat under layers of gray and rust
Rising from the ashes like a tower from the dust
He finds a broken promise in a shattered window pane
And learns to find the rhythm in the falling of the rain
[Chorus]
Light is breaking through the heavy gray
Turning every shadow into gold today
Rising from the ground where the spirit broke
Finding every word that the silence spoke
[Verse]
He traded in his worries for a vision sharp and wide
Finding all the anchors that were pulling from the tide
The mountains moved a mountain, and the valley felt the bloom
He chased away the ghosts that haunted every hollow room
Now the bricks are breathing in the rhythm of the street
Every steady heartbeat makes the symphony complete
He’s weaving every fragment into patterns bold and new
Painting every morning with a deeper shade of blue
[Chorus]
Light is breaking through the heavy gray
Turning every shadow into gold today
Rising from the ground where the spirit broke
Finding every word that the silence spoke
[Bridge]
The storm is fading into a soft and steady glow
The seeds of the past have finally started to grow
[Chorus]
Light is breaking through the heavy gray
Turning every shadow into gold today
Rising from the ground where the spirit broke
Finding every word that the silence spoke
[Outro]
